description: This file contains unit tests for the NetworkManager WiFi functionalities, using Google Test framework. It tests methods like WiFi disconnect/connect, getting WiFi state, scanning, and connecting to networks with various security configurations.

classes.name: NetworkManagerWifiTest
classes.description: Test fixture class for WiFi-related NetworkManager functions, sets up mocks, initializes plugin, and deinitializes afterwards.

methods.name: RegisteredMethods
methods.description: Test that core methods are registered and available in the JSON RPC handler.

methods.name: get_wifi_device_devices_null
methods.description: Test WiFi disconnect when device list is null.

methods.name: WiFiAlreadyDisconnected
methods.description: Test WiFi disconnect when device is already disconnected.

methods.name: WiFiAlreadyConnected_failed
methods.description: Test WiFi disconnect when device is connected; simulate disconnect failure.

methods.name: WiFiAlreadyConnected_failed_errorCode
methods.description: Test disconnect failure with specific error code message.

methods.name: WiFiAlreadyConnected_success
methods.description: Test successful WiFi disconnect when already connected.

methods.name: GetConnectedSSID_deviceError
methods.description: Test getting connected SSID when device reports error.

methods.name: GetConnectedSSID_ApNotConnected
methods.description: Test getting connected SSID when device is not connected.

methods.name: GetConnectedSSID_ApNotNull
methods.description: Test getting connected SSID with valid access point, mock returns network details including security, signal, frequency, etc.

methods.name: GetConnectedSSID_Connected_psk
methods.description: Test getting SSID details when connected to a network with WPA-PSK security.

methods.name: GetConnectedSSID_Connected_EAP
methods.description: Test getting SSID details for an EAP-secured network.

methods.name: GetConnectedSSID_Connected_ssidNull
methods.description: Test connected SSID when the SSID value is empty.

methods.name: GetWifiState_Disconnect
methods.description: Test getting WiFi state when device is disconnected.

methods.name: GetWifiState_Connected
methods.description: Test getting WiFi state when device is activated/connected.

methods.name: GetWifiState_Pairing
methods.description: Test WiFi state is pairing when in prepare or config states.

methods.name: GetWifiState_unknown
methods.description: Test WiFi state as disabled or unknown based on device states.

methods.name: GetWifiState_Connecting
methods.description: Test WiFi connecting in progress state.

methods.name: StartWiFiScan_with_SSIDList
methods.description: Test starting WiFi scan with specific SSID list.

methods.name: StartWiFiScan_with_Frequency
methods.description: Test starting WiFi scan with specific frequency parameter.

methods.name: StartWiFiScan_with_failed_with_error
methods.description: Test handling of scan request failure properly.

methods.name: StartWiFiScan_with_option_success
methods.description: Test starting WiFi scan with additional options successfully.

methods.name: WiFiConnect_long_ssid
methods.description: Test connecting to WiFi with a long SSID, expecting failure due to SSID length constraints.

methods.name: WiFiConnect_activateKnownConnection_failed_device_null
methods.description: Test WiFi connect when device is null, connection activation fails.

methods.name: WiFiConnect_activateKnownConnection_failed_noconnection
methods.description: Test failure in activating known connection when no connection object is returned.

methods.name: WiFiConnect_activateKnownConnection_failed_noconnection_null
methods.description: Test failure in activating known connection when connection type is null.

methods.name: WiFiConnect_activateKnownConnection_failed
methods.description: Test failure during connection activation process.

methods.name: WiFiConnect_activateKnownConnection_success
methods.description: Test successful connection activation for known connection.

methods.name: WiFiConnect_with_same_ssid
methods.description: Test connecting to same SSID when already connected, expecting success.

methods.name: WiFiConnect_with_Ap_list_null
methods.description: Test connect when access point list is null, expecting connection failure.

methods.name: WiFiConnect_with_no_access_point
methods.description: Test connection attempt when no access points are found.

methods.name: WiFiConnect_with_different_ssid
methods.description: Test connection to a different SSID when similar network is active.

methods.name: AddToKnownSSIDs_deviceFailed
methods.description: Test adding to known SSID list when device is unmanaged or fails.

methods.name: AddToKnownSSIDs_SmallPssword
methods.description: Test adding to known SSID with a small passphrase.

methods.name: AddToKnownSSIDs_sae_failed
methods.description: Test adding SAE security network when operation fails.

methods.name: AddToKnownSSIDs_sae_update_success
methods.description: Test successful update of known SSID with SAE security method.

methods.name: AddToKnownSSIDs_sae_update_failed
methods.description: Test failure updating SAE security network.

methods.name: AddToKnownSSIDs_sae_success
methods.description: Test success adding a SAE secured network.

methods.name: AddToKnownSSIDs_eap_success
methods.description: Test successful addition of an EAP security network with full credentials.

methods.name: GetKnownSSIDs_connectionFailed
methods.description: Test retrieval of known SSIDs when connection fetch fails.

methods.name: GetKnownSSIDs_success
methods.description: Test retrieval of known SSIDs list successfully.

methods.name: RemoveKnownSSIDs
methods.description: Test removal of known SSIDs when device is managed.

methods.name: RemoveKnownSSIDs_success_false
methods.description: Test removal with failure in delete operation which returns false.

methods.name: RemoveKnownSSIDs_success_true
methods.description: Test successful removal of known SSID.

methods.name: RemoveKnownSSIDs_conn_id_null
methods.description: Test removal when connection ID is null, so deletion is skipped or considered successful.

methods.description: Test removal when specified SSID is not found.

methods.name: RemoveKnownSSIDs_success_ssid_specified_found
